name: File Edits
description: Tabbed file viewer with multiple tab types (diff, markdown). V1 of the files-applet generalization (docs/files-applet-v1.md). Successor to file-edits / markdown-viewer.

agentUsage.purpose: Tabbed file viewer. Diff tabs (the original file-edits behavior) auto-open on agent edits and show live diff cards. Markdown tabs render .md files with live re-render on external edit. Open files via the + button; the chevron (▾) offers a type override.
